text:
Like empty beer cans and cigarette

butts gone out, so have my days been.

Like figures passing across a television screen

and disappearing, so has my life passed.

Like automobiles that sped along the highways

with girls' laughter and radio music...

And beauty passed quickly, like the model of cars

and the songs on radios that went out of fashion.

And nothing has remained of those days, nothing,

except empty cans and extinguished butts,

laughter in faded photos, torn tickets,

and the sawdust with which at dawn they swept the bars.

translation.title: Like Empty Beer Cans and Butts
translation.editorial_note: The source has a typo in 'television'; the translation follows the intended image of a life passing across a screen.
